weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Set the body weight of the generated model in kilograms. This affects the body shape and proportions.

ethnicity.title: Ethnicity
ethnicity.description: Select the ethnicity of the generated model. This affects skin tone, facial features, and overall appearance.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Choose the gender and age category for the generated model. This determines the body type and appearance of the person in the final image.

background.title: Background
background.description: Choose the studio backdrop color for the generated image. Different backgrounds work better for different clothing colors.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Describe additional details for the generated image. This helps guide the AI to create more specific results.
prompt.placeholder: e.g. Studio fashion model wearing the outfit, natural lighting...

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Welcome to your dashboard. Here you can manage your account and settings.

users.title: Users
users.description: View, search, and manage user accounts. Ban users who violate platform policies.

create.title: Create a user
create.description: Create a new user account. This user will be able to log in and use the platform.

ban.title: Ban User
ban.description: This action will ban <name></name> from the platform. They will no longer be able to log in or use any features.
ban.durationDescription: How long should the user be banned? Enter duration in days.
ban.reasonDescription: Provide a reason for banning this user. This will be visible to the user.

confirm.title: Are you absolutely sure?

confirm.title: Unban user?
confirm.description: You are about to restore access for <name></name>. They will be able to log in and use the platform again.

confirm.title: Delete user?
confirm.description: You are about to permanently delete <name></name>. This action cannot be undone and all their data will be lost.
